patterns.singleton_pattern: Use 'object' keyword for singletons (e.g., AdbManager, PrefsManager)
patterns.preferences_pattern: PrefsManager uses private const keys, getter/setter methods with context parameter
patterns.service_pattern: Foreground service with companion object for start/stop, notification channel setup in onCreate
patterns.viewmodel_pattern: AndroidViewModel with MutableLiveData private, exposed as LiveData, uses viewModelScope for coroutines
patterns.ui_pattern: Fragment with ViewBinding, observers for LiveData in observeViewModel(), uses Toast for user feedback
patterns.async_pattern: suspend functions in managers, viewModelScope.launch {} in ViewModels
patterns.notification_pattern: NotificationCompat.Builder with channel ID, persistent notification for foreground service
